pattern: <explicit noun subject> ma <reviewed future stem> <reviewed negative future auxiliary>
source: Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012) — Shaxannada CUN, p. 922
note: The non-finite future stem does not carry subject agreement. Negative future auxiliary morphology is kept distinct from affirmative future morphology; unknown forms are not derived from suffixes.

source: Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012) — Shaxannada CUN, p. 922
note: For 2pl and 3pl the auxiliary surface is syncretic across affirmative and negative paradigms, so ma supplies the polarity context. No generic ma + affirmative transformation is used.
